items.title: WHY COLLECT THEM
cards: Sell rare cards at pawn shops. Some are worth over $1,000 each.

items.title: VICE CITY
cards: La Perle. On the roof railing of the Imperial Plaza apartments, NW 9th Ave.
Balsero. On the parapet of the north tower above Merlin's Palace Casino, NW 15th Ave.

items.title: VICE BEACH
cards: Vespucci Island. TV stand, 2nd floor of the modern mansion on the north-west coast.
Ocean Beach. Between two magazines next to a bed, rooftop courtyard of the Ocean Beach Apartments, Huevo St.

items.title: MARIANA COUNTY
cards: Capri. Top of the tower behind the Leonida Brewing Company warehouse, Sweetbay Rd.
Breakwater Quarry. Next to a backpack in an abandoned train car by the tracks.

items.title: KELLY COUNTY
cards: Port Gellhorn. In a safe in the storage room of the abandoned Gellhorn Drive-In theater.
Buckskin Swamp. On a bench in the small picnic area in the middle of the swamp.

items.title: LEONARD COUNTY
cards: Belville. Under a mannequin's hand, yellow house at Prosperity St and Grace Ave.
Little Hardin Island. Half-buried in the sand next to a lone chair at the southern tip.

items.title: LUMMOX COUNTY
cards: MacAlister Gold Mine. On a red blanket in the cave through the mountain.
Millport. Under a lawn chair by a white mobile home on Forest Mill Rd.
